what: Timestamped external legal signals: the layer that moves before the judgment corpus does. Legislative, regulatory, judicial-institutional, technological, infrastructural and emerging-subject events, each with what its source establishes and what it does not.
captureRule: an event whose first_recorded_at is on or before prospectiveFrom is a BACKFILLED_EVENT: it may calibrate a method and may NEVER support a claim that this observatory anticipated anything. Only signals first recorded after that date are PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE. The class is computed from the timestamps by leading.py, not declared here.

taxonomy.A_LEGISLATIVE: new statute, amendment, repeal, commencement, implementing regulation, official statutory interpretation
taxonomy.B_REGULATORY: new regulation, regulator rule, official consultation, binding framework, major compliance requirement
taxonomy.C_JUDICIAL_INSTITUTIONAL: court procedure change, judicial principle publication, new digital judicial workflow, publication-policy change
taxonomy.D_TECHNOLOGY_AI: verified judicial or legal-research AI deployment, government legal AI, AI governance instrument
taxonomy.E_INFRASTRUCTURE: new official legal database, source-publication change, new precedent publication, open-data release
taxonomy.F_EMERGING_SUBJECT: an official event that creates a plausible future dispute class

sourceGrades.S1_PRIMARY_OFFICIAL: the issuing body's own publication, read by us
sourceGrades.S2_OFFICIAL_AGENCY_REPORT: an official agency or national platform, read or summarised
sourceGrades.S3_RELIABLE_SECONDARY_CONFIRMATION: reputable secondary sources agreeing on an official act
sourceGrades.S4_SECONDARY_ONLY: secondary only; may create a WATCH item but never a core forecast trigger unless independently verified

seedScope: ONE bounded official-source pass. Priority: major instruments newly enacted or commencing, official amendments, official legal or judicial AI deployments, official court and publication-system changes. Not a news database. After the seed, updates happen prospectively.

signals.title: Announcement of four new laws reforming the judicial institutions: Personal Status, Civil Transactions, Penal Code for Discretionary Sentences, Law of Evidence
signals.observable_in_courts_from: 1443Q1 for the Law of Evidence; 1445Q1 for the Civil Transactions Law, as first observed in this corpus
signals.verified_facts: four named laws were announced as a programme
signals.claims_not_established: commencement dates for each; this announcement is not a commencement
signals.notes: this is the known_at for both calibration cases in leading_results.json. It is why those two instruments are the only clean arrivals the corpus contains.

signals.title: Law of Evidence enters observable use
signals.verified_facts: the instrument exists and is cited in this corpus from 1443Q1
signals.claims_not_established: the exact commencement date is not held in the registry, so uptake latency is measured from first OBSERVED use

signals.title: Civil Transactions Law enters observable use
signals.verified_facts: first court and first party citation both in 1445Q1; top-100 by 1445Q2; top-50 by 1445Q3
signals.claims_not_established: commencement date not held; the bar's heavier citation rate is not evidence that the bar drove adoption

signals.title: A new Enforcement Law welcomed by the Minister of Justice as part of legal modernisation
signals.observable_in_courts_from: UNKNOWN: enforcement output is not published as reasoned judgments and is not in this corpus
signals.verified_facts: an official statement welcoming a new enforcement law exists and is dated
signals.claims_not_established: its commencement date, its contents, and whether any of it becomes visible in commercial adjudication. Our own fetch of the SPA page was not completed.
expectedObservables: instrument visibility in the commercial corpus, if any
signals.notes: expected observables are deliberately thin. The workflow it touches is not the workflow this corpus records.

signals.title: Board of Grievances principles for the use of AI systems
signals.observable_in_courts_from: NOT_OBSERVABLE: the Board is not in this corpus
signals.verified_facts: a mandatory internal AI-use policy exists, applying to all departments and to operating companies
signals.claims_not_established: which systems, at what volume, with what effect

signals.title: Ministry of Justice Virtual Enforcement Court launched
signals.observable_in_courts_from: NOT_OBSERVABLE: enforcement output is not in this corpus
signals.verified_facts: the Ministry states enforcement requests run automatically without human intervention under judicial supervision
signals.claims_not_established: the Ministry's own page does not mention artificial intelligence

signals.title: Board of Grievances publishes the administrative judgments collection for 1444 AH
signals.verified_facts: a collection covering 1444 AH was issued and was still described as the latest in July 2025
signals.claims_not_established: whether a 1445 or later collection exists; our own fetch of the Board's pages was blocked
signals.notes: this is the publication-coverage fact that closes the Board AI study at E0.

shocksView.definition: a SHOCK here is a timestamped external legal event of system-wide scope. The word carries no causal claim.
